name: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
authors: Xuezhi Wang, Jason Wei, Dale Schuurmans, Quoc Le, Ed H. Chi, Sharan Narang, Aakanksha Chowdhery, Denny Zhou (Google Research, Brain Team)
code_url: [uncertain] (No dedicated official code release in the paper; UL2-20B checkpoints are public at https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/ul2, but the self-consistency method itself was not released as a standalone repository)
reflection_type: calibration/probing | self-ensemble via majority vote (an implicit form of self-checking: diverse reasoning paths are sampled and the most consistent answer is selected; no explicit verbal self-critique or external verifier)
feedback_source: self-generated (the agreement/consistency signal among multiple sampled reasoning paths from the same model; no external tool, no ground-truth oracle, no human annotation)
iteration_structure: single-shot (one round of parallel sampling: ~40 reasoning paths sampled independently, then aggregated by marginalization; no iterative refinement and no retry loop)
reflection_object: reasoning chain / output content — the method reflects across multiple sampled chains-of-thought (latent reasoning paths r_i) and their final answers a_i; it marginalizes out the reasoning paths and selects the most consistent final answer. Nothing in the prompt, weights, or trajectory is modified.
learning_locus: in_context_verbal (no weight update; it is a pure inference-time decoding strategy applied to a frozen pre-trained model)
requires_training: none (entirely unsupervised, works off-the-shelf with pre-trained LMs, no fine-tuning, no auxiliary models, no human annotation)
reward_or_critic_model: none — there is no trained reward/critic model; the 'signal' is purely the consistency (majority agreement) among sampled answers. The paper explicitly contrasts this with prior work that trained a verifier (Cobbe et al. 2021) or re-ranker (Thoppilan et al. 2022).
distillation_target: none in the core method (the gain is realized at inference time only). The authors note as future work that self-consistency could be used to generate better supervised data to fine-tune the model into single-pass accuracy (i.e. distill into model-weights), but this is not implemented in the paper.
emergent_vs_engineered: engineered — a hand-designed sample-and-marginalize decoding scaffold layered on top of CoT prompting; the reflective/self-ensemble behavior is not RL-emergent.
memory_type: none (stateless; no scratchpad, episodic memory, or skill library — each question is answered by independent parallel samples)
memory_persistence: within-episode (the only 'persistence' is holding the m=~40 sampled answers for the single question's aggregation; nothing carries across questions/tasks/sessions)
memory_curation_mechanism: n/a (no persistent memory to curate; aggregation is a one-shot majority vote / marginalization over the current question's sampled paths)
error_localization_granularity: holistic/outcome-level — selection operates on the final parsed answer a_i (marginalizing out reasoning paths via majority vote over answers); individual erroneous reasoning steps are not localized or corrected. Incorrect chains are simply outvoted, not repaired.
intra_task_vs_inter_task: intra-task — improvement is realized within a single task instance by aggregating multiple parallel attempts at the same question; no experience or signal is transferred across different tasks.
failure_recovery_vs_avoidance: post-hoc-revision (answer-selection): the final answer is chosen post-hoc by consensus over completed reasoning paths. There is no mid-trajectory recovery (chains are not corrected in-flight) and no cross-episode avoidance.
task_domains: QA/reasoning — arithmetic reasoning, commonsense reasoning, and symbolic reasoning (plus NLI-style NLP tasks where CoT can otherwise hurt). Limited to tasks with a fixed answer set.
benchmarks: GSM8K, SVAMP, AQuA (AQUA-RAT), AddSub, MultiArith, ASDiv (arithmetic); CommonsenseQA (CSQA), StrategyQA, ARC-easy, ARC-challenge (commonsense); Last Letter Concatenation, Coinflip (symbolic, OOD 4-letter/4-flip); ANLI, e-SNLI, RTE (NLP tasks).
headline_result: On PaLM-540B/GPT-3, self-consistency (40 sampled paths) yields large absolute accuracy gains over CoT greedy decoding: GSM8K +17.9%, SVAMP +11.0%, AQuA +12.2%, StrategyQA +6.4%, ARC-challenge +3.9%. On PaLM-540B, GSM8K rises from 56.5% (CoT) to 74.4% (majority vote).
baselines: Primary baseline: chain-of-thought prompting with greedy decoding (Wei et al. 2022). Also compared against sample-and-rank (by log-prob), beam search decoding, prompt-order-permutation ensemble, multi-prompt ensemble, model ensembles, and prior task-specific SoTA (including GPT-3 175B fine-tuned + 175B verifier of Cobbe et al. 2021).
gains_vs_baseline: vs the strongest comparable baseline (CoT greedy decoding on the same model): +3-6% absolute on UL2-20B; +9-23% on LaMDA-137B and GPT-3; +12-18% on AQuA/GSM8K and +7-11% on SVAMP/ASDiv for the largest models (PaLM-540B, GPT-3 code-davinci-002). Self-consistency also significantly outperforms sample-and-rank, beam search, and prompt/multi-prompt ensembles at the same sample budget, and beats CoT robustly even on NLP tasks (ANLI/e-SNLI/RTE) where adding CoT hurt standard prompting. Achieves new SoTA on most arithmetic and 5/6 commonsense+symbolic tasks despite being unsupervised.
compute_cost_profile: Inference cost multiplier of ~m sampled paths per question (paper reports results averaged over 10 runs of 40 samples each; default m=40). The authors note self-consistency 'incurs more computation cost' and that performance saturates quickly, so 5-10 paths recover most of the gain at much lower cost. No additional training cost (no fine-tuning, no verifier training).
known_limitations: (1) Incurs higher inference compute (multiple sampled paths per question). (2) Applicable only to tasks with a fixed/closed answer set where consistency can be measured by exact answer agreement (not directly to open-ended generation without a defined consistency metric). (3) Models can still generate incorrect or nonsensical reasoning paths that happen to agree on the answer (correct answer from flawed rationale), so rationale grounding remains unsolved. (4) Gains are smaller for smaller models because certain abilities only emerge at sufficient scale.
oracle_or_external_feedback_dependency: intrinsic-only / self-verify — uses NO ground-truth labels, no external tool/verifier, and no human feedback. The improvement signal is purely the model's own answer agreement (self-consistency), which is why the gains are genuine and not label-leakage artifacts. This contrasts sharply with later critiques (Huang et al., Kamoi et al.) of intrinsic self-correction methods that secretly rely on oracle labels.
self_correction_efficacy: net-positive — improves accuracy across all four models and nearly all tasks without any oracle/label leakage. It is one of the clearest demonstrations that an intrinsic, label-free aggregation signal robustly helps; gains are largest for larger models and harder tasks.
calibration_effect: improves — the paper shows that consistency (percentage of decodes agreeing with the aggregated answer) is highly correlated with accuracy, so low consistency serves as an uncertainty/low-confidence indicator ('know when it doesn't know'). Separately, the authors note the raw model is NOT well-calibrated at the per-path log-probability level (normalized probabilities are nearly identical across correct/incorrect paths), which is why unweighted majority vote works as well as probability-weighted aggregation.
failure_attribution_capability: n/a (this is a decoding/inference method, not a failure-analysis or attribution method; it does not classify failure modes or attribute responsible steps/agents)
failure_mode_addressed: Targets single-sample stochasticity and the local-optimality/repetitiveness of greedy decoding in CoT, i.e. the failure where one sampled chain makes an error and the model cannot recover. By marginalizing over diverse paths it outvotes individual erroneous reasoning chains. It does NOT address rationale faithfulness (a wrong rationale can still reach a right answer) and does not handle MAST-style multi-agent failures (it is single-agent).
dataset_or_benchmark_released: n/a — no new dataset or benchmark was released; the method is evaluated on existing public benchmarks (GSM8K, SVAMP, AQuA, etc.).
builds_on: Chain-of-Thought prompting (Wei et al. 2022); few-shot in-context learning / GPT-3 (Brown et al. 2020); verifier-based GSM8K reranking (Cobbe et al. 2021) and LaMDA reranking (Thoppilan et al. 2022) as the supervised approaches it replaces; classic sampling/decoding methods (temperature sampling, top-k, nucleus sampling, minimum Bayes risk decoding).
extended_by_or_inspired: Universal Self-Consistency (USC, Chen et al. 2023) extending it to free-form/open-ended outputs via LLM-judged consistency; Tree of Thoughts (Yao et al. 2023) and complexity-based/multi-path prompting; verifier- and reward-model-guided sampling and best-of-N / weighted majority voting in process-reward-model work (e.g. Let's Verify Step by Step); STaR-style bootstrapping that uses sampled rationales; and the broad family of inference-time / test-time compute scaling methods. It is the canonical 'majority-vote ensemble' baseline for LLM reasoning.
reasoning_model_native: Partly — predates o1/R1-style reasoning models, but the principle (sampling multiple reasoning paths and majority-voting) remains a standard test-time scaling technique applied to reasoning models. Modern reasoning models have internalized some single-chain reflection, yet self-consistency / majority-vote@k is still commonly layered on top of them (e.g. cons@64 on AIME), so it holds for but is not native to such models.
on_policy_distillation_link: Indirect — the core method does no distillation, but the authors explicitly suggest using self-consistency to generate higher-quality supervised data to fine-tune the model toward accurate single-pass inference, which is conceptually a self-distillation / on-policy-data-generation link later realized by STaR, ReST, and self-training pipelines that distill multi-sample consensus into weights.
sample_efficiency: Reaches reported gains with m=40 sampled reasoning paths (results averaged over 10 runs); the accuracy-vs-paths ablation (1, 5, 10, 20, 40) shows monotonic improvement, with most of the gain captured by ~5-10 paths and saturation by ~40.
